title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
abstract: arXiv:2608.07458v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent optimization studies on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have exploited chunk-level KV cache reuse to avoid processing long retrieved contexts for higher efficiency, while significant information redundancy and noise still remain in the coarse-grained chunks. This paper optimizes the Pareto frontier under low prefill latency constraints while maximizing accuracy by proposing CoinRAG (Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG). The name metaphorically reflects our core mechanism: much like assembling small tokens (or "coins") to accumulate a larger value, CoinRAG compositionally reuses offline-computed, fine-grained nugget caches to form a learned contextual representation efficiently in a more semantically relevant but compact manner. Specifically, instead of full-chunk encoding, CoinRAG identifies query-relevant semantic units within retrieved chunks through two-stage retrieval and seamle

translated_title: CoinRAG：面向长上下文检索增强生成（RAG）的上下文化信息微块KV缓存复用
translated_abstract: 近期关于检索增强生成（RAG）的优化研究利用块级KV缓存复用来避免对冗长的检索上下文进行重复处理，从而提高效率；然而粗粒度的块中仍然存在显著的信息冗余与噪声。本文提出CoinRAG（面向长上下文RAG的上下文化信息微块KV缓存复用），在低预填充延迟的约束下优化帕累托前沿，同时最大化准确性。该名称隐喻性地体现了我们的核心机制：正如将小代币（“硬币”）拼合起来可以累积出更大的价值，CoinRAG以组合的方式复用离线计算的细粒度微块缓存，以语义上更相关且更紧凑的方式高效地构建学习到的上下文表示。具体而言，CoinRAG不再对整个块进行编码，而是通过两阶段检索来识别检索块中与查询相关的语义单元，并无缝地……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: CoinRAG通过两阶段检索定位查询相关语义单元，并以组合方式复用离线计算的细粒度信息微块KV缓存，在低预填充延迟下实现了长上下文RAG效率与准确性的帕累托最优。
en_tdlr: CoinRAG identifies query-relevant semantic units via two-stage retrieval and compositionally reuses offline-computed fine-grained nugget KV caches, optimizing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier for long-context RAG under low prefill latency constraints.
